{{Quote|You know how they say "the house always wins"? I'm the house. Take me on, and it will be the last thing you ever do.|Arkan|<ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=message|You and Otheros|Arkan}}</ref>}}
'''Arkan''', also known by the nickname '''Arkan the Shark''', was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the owner and "Supreme Executive Officer" of the [[Lucky Runner]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]], a position he obtained by first murdering his way into the casino and then murdering its staff until he reached his current position. Arkan hired a number of "debt facilitators" who were in fact street [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|gangsters]] likened to himself. However, the Lucky Runner's business clashing with the [[Haven's Blaze]] casino prompted the latter's owner, [[Otheros]], to put a bounty on Arkan and his [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]].<ref name="WK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arkan first appeared in Game Update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]]. He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event as the Nar Shaddaa Kingpin Bounty.
